purpose: Super Admin can create a hostel master record
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/hostel/hostels with code=H001, name=Hostel A, gender=boys, capacity=100
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created with hostel_id and code H001

purpose: Duplicate hostel code is rejected
preconditions: Hostel with code H001 already exists
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request with duplicate code error

purpose: Super Admin assigns Warden to hostel via role binding
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created with role binding active

purpose: Super Admin creates room under existing hostel
preconditions: Hostel exists; Super Admin authenticated with hostel.room.manage
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/hostel/rooms with hostel_id, number=101, capacity=3, room_type=standard
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created with room_id and status=available

purpose: Student submits accommodation request for hostel allocation
Super Admin batch allots students to rooms
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/hostel/allotments/batch with list of student_id and room_id pairs
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created with allotment records; request status becomes allotted

purpose: Allotment fails when room capacity is exceeded
Caretaker records daily attendance for a hostel
preconditions: Caretaker authenticated with hostel.attendance.manage; students allotted
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/hostel/attendance with hostel_id, date, attendance list

purpose: Student submits leave request
preconditions: Student authenticated with hostel.leave.create; student allotted

purpose: Caretaker approves a submitted leave request
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with status=approved; student notified

purpose: Invalid leave state transition is rejected
Student submits hostel complaint
Complaint with empty category is rejected
Caretaker resolves a submitted complaint
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with status=resolved and resolved_at timestamp

purpose: Warden books a guest room
preconditions: Guest room available; Warden authenticated with hostel.guest.manage

purpose: Warden approves a guest room booking
Student submits extended stay request
Warden approves extended stay request
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with status=approved; charge recorded

purpose: Warden records a fine for a student
preconditions: Student allotted; Warden authenticated with hostel.fine.manage
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/hostel/fines with student_user_id, amount=500, reason=Rule violation
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created with fine_id and status=recorded

purpose: Fine with zero amount is rejected
Caretaker records inventory item for hostel
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/hostel/inventory with hostel_id, name=Chair, quantity=10, condition=working

purpose: Caretaker logs staff duty record
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/hostel/staff-duties with staff_user_id, duty_role=cleaning, date, shift
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created with duty log entry

purpose: Caretaker records security guard shift
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/hostel/security-shifts with guard_user_id, hostel_id, date, shift

purpose: Warden publishes hostel notice
preconditions: Warden authenticated with hostel.notice.manage for assigned hostel
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/hostel/notices with hostel_id, title, content, priority=important

purpose: Warden cannot publish notice for unassigned hostel
preconditions: Warden authenticated but hostel not in assigned list

purpose: Super Admin can view all hostels across institution
preconditions: Multiple hostels exist; Super Admin authenticated

purpose: Warden sees only hostels they are assigned to
preconditions: Warden assigned to Hostel 1 only; Hostel 2 also exists

purpose: Student sees only their allocated hostel data
Room exchange between two students is processed
preconditions: Both students allotted in same hostel; Warden authenticated

purpose: Notification is sent to student on allotment
expected_result: HostelNotification record created with event=room_allocation for student
